papers.title: Processing Speed Accounts for the Discriminative Power of a Smartphone Go/No-Go Task in Multiple Sclerosis
papers.reason: This study evaluates a smartphone inhibitory-control task as a digital cognitive marker in multiple sclerosis and identifies processing speed as the source of its discrimination.

papers.title: What Static Connectivity Misses: Dynamic Alpha-Band Brain Network States in First-Episode Psychosis
papers.reason: Dynamic alpha-band connectivity in psychosis could inform neural models of attention, but the title does not establish a direct executive-function analysis.

papers.title: Air pollution and cognitive outcomes in older adults: a systematic review
papers.reason: The review concerns cognition in older adults but is primarily about environmental exposure rather than executive mechanisms or computational assessment.

papers.title: Data-driven subtypes of Alzheimer's Disease: A multicohort study
papers.reason: Data-driven Alzheimer’s subtyping is relevant to clinical stratification, but no executive-function or task-based biomarker focus is evident from the available information.

papers.title: Predictive Value of Abnormal Expression of miR-378a-3p in Elderly Stroke Patients for Cognitive Impairment After Stroke.
papers.reason: This is a molecular predictor of general post-stroke cognitive impairment without a meaningful executive-function or digital-assessment component.

papers.title: Distinct oscillatory neural rhythms support representational precision and confidence in working memory.
papers.reason: The paper directly identifies oscillatory mechanisms supporting working-memory precision and confidence, providing findings well suited to computational process models.

papers.title: Altered Intertemporal Decision-Making in Individuals with High Autistic Traits.
papers.reason: Intertemporal choice is a model-relevant decision process, and its alteration with autistic traits may inform computational accounts of valuation and cognitive control.

papers.title: Knowledge-Guided Deep Learning with Clinical EEG Biomarkers for Automated Dementia Detection and Staging
papers.reason: The study closely matches clinical biomarker work by integrating raw multichannel EEG and established neurophysiological features to detect MCI and stage dementia.

papers.title: Plasma Cluster of Differentiation 147 and Cognitive Impairment After Acute Ischemic Stroke.
papers.reason: The study predicts general post-stroke impairment from a plasma biomarker rather than modelling executive function or using task-based or neurophysiological digital markers.

papers.title: Visual impairment and its association with cognitive impairment: the Handan Eye Follow-up Study.
papers.reason: The paper addresses an epidemiological association with general cognitive impairment rather than executive processes, eye-tracking behaviour, or computational assessment.

papers.title: Synergistic effects of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation and a dance movement intervention on mild cognitive impairment: study protocol for a four-arm factorial randomized controlled trial
papers.reason: The protocol targets the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and includes executive-function and P300 outcomes, but it does not yet report empirical findings.

papers.title: Cognition and Heart Failure Subtypes: A Large Health Care System Real-World Cohort.
papers.reason: This cohort links heart-failure subtypes to global MoCA impairment without isolating executive mechanisms or developing a relevant digital biomarker.

papers.title: Educational bias in the Montreal Cognitive Assessment among hemodialysis patients: A domain-level analysis.
papers.reason: The domain-level analysis demonstrates education-related bias in MoCA attention and executive items, directly informing the validity of cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Latent profile classification of cognitive function and its influencing factors in elderly patients with chronic pain after stroke
papers.reason: Latent profile analysis identifies clinically distinct MoCA patterns after stroke, but the profiles emphasize global cognition rather than executive-function mechanisms.

papers.title: Cognitive functioning as an underutilized determinant of treatment planning: a review in alcohol use disorder
papers.reason: The review substantially covers executive function, attention, and memory in alcohol use disorder, although its main concern is treatment planning rather than cognitive mechanisms.

papers.title: Cenobamate Improves Emotional Dysregulation, Impulsivity, and Apathy in Drug-Resistant Focal Epilepsy: A Longitudinal Neuropsychological Study.
papers.reason: The longitudinal battery measures impulsivity, working memory, Stroop performance, and related control functions, but the primary contribution concerns medication effects in epilepsy.

papers.title: Dynamic, differentiated clinical trajectories and prediction in clinical high risk for psychosis.
papers.reason: The available title concerns clinical trajectory prediction in psychosis without an identifiable cognitive, executive-function, or neurophysiological assessment component.

papers.title: What bilingualism demands
papers.reason: The review discusses cognitive control and EEG dynamics in bilingual language processing, but language and interdisciplinary theory remain its central focus.

papers.title: Entropy-Based Analysis of Olfactory EEG as a Candidate Biomarker for Early Mild Cognitive Impairment Detection: A Proof-of-Concept Study
papers.reason: The study combines an olfactory oddball task, EEG entropy features, and subject-level classification to distinguish MCI from healthy controls.

papers.title: Investigating the DTI-ALPS index and its association with cognitive impairment in Alzheimer’s disease: a diffusion tensor imaging study
papers.reason: The study relates glymphatic and white-matter imaging measures to cognition in Alzheimer’s disease, but it does not specifically examine executive-function circuitry.

papers.title: Cognitive Trajectories and Associated Factors in Prostate Cancer Survivors Over a 3-Year Prospective Study.
papers.reason: Longitudinal cognitive trajectories have general assessment relevance, but no specific executive-function or computational focus is evident from the title.

papers.title: 529. **Rafaelsen Award Presentation** Cognitive function and the risk of later onset of depression in healthy individuals: a 10-year longitudinal study
papers.reason: The longitudinal study tests working memory and processing speed as predictors of depression onset, finding predictive value for processing speed but not working memory.

papers.title: 420. Neurophysiological and cognitive markers for panic disorder: a multimodal predictive modeling study
papers.reason: This close methodological match integrates EEG, autonomic measures, memory, and inhibitory-control performance to classify panic disorder against healthy controls.

papers.title: 674. Cognitive and neurobiological indicators of risk and prognosis in mood disorders
papers.reason: The reported cohorts connect cognitive impairment and cognitive-control circuitry with mood-disorder risk and prognosis, although executive mechanisms are not isolated in detail.

papers.title: 519. Baseline EEG connectivity predicts differential clinical response to donepezil and memantine in Alzheimer’s disease
papers.reason: Baseline frequency-specific EEG connectivity is evaluated as a biomarker of differential Alzheimer’s treatment response, with attention-relevant gamma-network findings.

papers.title: 68. Predicting executive dysfunction in mood disorders using a multimodal machine learning approach
papers.reason: The study develops multimodal speech-based machine-learning biomarkers that predict WCST-defined executive dysfunction in mood disorders and healthy controls.

papers.title: Investigating the Impact of Computer‐Based Cognitive Rehabilitation on Cognitive Function of Elderly People With Diabetes and Mild Cognitive Impairment: Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.reason: The trial directly targets working memory, selective attention, and inhibitory control using N-back, Stroop, and Go/No-Go outcomes, although it is only a protocol.

papers.title: 203. Sharpening focus: EEG evidence of attention network plasticity following adaptive working memory training in adult ADHD
papers.reason: The study directly links working-memory training to behavioural and N100/P300 changes in alerting, orienting, and executive-control networks in adult ADHD.

papers.title: Ebetsu Active Future Study (EAFS): cognitive function and physical and mental health in elderly residents of Ebetsu City, Japan - cohort profile.
papers.reason: The cohort supports longitudinal MCI detection and biomarker research but currently reports only broad cognitive, health, and biospecimen characterization.
